content: {"action": "submit", "tool_call_id": "submit_answer_0_6ee62a24", "answer": {"baseline_summary": {"verification": ["employee ID", "manager confirmation"], "target": "contractor account", "sla_hours": 8}, "recommendation": "To safely recover a contractor account, implement the following workflow: 1) Intake the recovery request and record the timestamp to track against the 8-hour SLA. 2) Verify the requester’s identity by checking their employee ID against the authoritative employee directory. 3) Obtain manager confirmation through a direct, out-of-band communication channel (e.g., phone or secure messaging) to prevent spoofing; document the confirmation reference. 4) As a defense-in-depth improvement, optionally seek independent sponsor confirmation, noting that this is recommended but not required under the current policy. 5) Once both required verifications are satisfied, execute the account recovery procedure. 6) Confirm successful recovery with the requester and close the ticket within the SLA window. 7) Retain audit logs of all verification and recovery actions.", "quality_notes": ["The current visible policy mandates only employee ID and manager confirmation for contractor account recovery.", "Independent sponsor confirmation is a recommended defense-in-depth control but is not a policy requirement.", "The workflow must be completed within the 8-hour SLA; timestamps should be recorded at intake and resolution.", "Manager confirmation should be performed via an out-of-band channel to reduce the risk of email or messaging compromise.", "All verification decisions and recovery actions must be logged to support future audits."]}}
